title: Benefits Value Calculator
description: Compute total compensation: salary plus health, retirement match and PTO value.
howto: Enter the employer-paid health insurance value per year.
Enter your contribution %, the employer match rate %, and the match cap % to compute the match dollars.
Enter PTO days and other perks, then read your total compensation.

faqs.q: How is the employer match computed?
faqs.a: The match applies to your contribution up to the cap: salary times the smaller of your contribution % and the cap %, times the match rate %.
Each PTO day is valued at salary divided by 260 working days.
Anything with a cash value: transit passes, wellness stipends, tuition help, free meals. Enter the yearly total.
